_comment: End-to-end fixture for the Duet3 Mini 5+ (SAME54P20 / samd51p20 build) via renode in DETERMINISTIC TICK MODE. tick_mode puts klippy and Renode in lockstep over the tick socket (one `emulation RunFor` per klippy `advance T`, with a synchronous sercom0<->pty byte shuttle), so the SAMX5 DWT->CYCCNT clock advances at exactly CONFIG_CLOCK_FREQ (120 MHz, pinned in samd51p20.repl) instead of the wall-clock-bound JIT rate that drifts in free-run. sw_uart is auto-emitted and routes to the renode 6-arg form; the four TMC2209s are multi-drop on PA1/PA0 (uart_address 0..3), and renode_hooks.sw_uart drives the firmware RX bit through the SAMD51 PORT model (gpio_a.OnGPIO) - one shared state + register file serves all four addresses because klippy initialises drivers sequentially. The thermistors read through adc_scaled (vref_pin PB5 / vssa_pin PB4) against the SAMX5 ADC1 (0x43002000), served by test/emulator/samd51_adc_stub.py: all four channels are on ADC1 - vref=chan 7, vssa=chan 6, extruder PC1=chan 11, bed PC0=chan 10. vref (7800) and vssa (100) get distinct values so the (vref - vssa) divisor in extras/adc_scaled.py is non-zero; the two sensors (7720) read ~36 C after the vref/vssa scaling, inside the extruder [0,285] and bed [0,130] ranges. Values reach the stub through renode_hooks adc_set, which pokes magic offsets 0x104+ch*4; the stub returns RESULT for whichever channel INPUTCTRL.MUXPOS last selected.
